import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 31;
    static final long P = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static long[][] matrix = new long[MAX][MAX];

    static class Mat {
        long[][] t = new long[MAX][MAX];

        void setIdentity() {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void multiply(Mat b) {
            long[][] temp = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        temp[i][k] += t[i][j] * b.t[j][k] % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = temp[i][j] % P;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m_in = sc.nextLong();
        int k_in = sc.nextInt();
        long m = m_in;
        int k = k_in;

        List<Long> digitsVec = new ArrayList<>();
        while (m > 0) {
            digitsVec.add(m % k);
            m /= k;
        }

        n = k + 1;

        Mat baseMat = new Mat();
        Mat idMat = new Mat();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            baseMat.t[i][(i + 1) % k] = 1;
        }
        baseMat.t[k][k] = 1;

        idMat.setIdentity();

        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            baseMat.t[0][i] = 1;
            baseMat.t[i][i] = 1;
        }

        List<Mat> dMat = new ArrayList<>();
        dMat.add(new Mat());
        dMat.get(0).setIdentity();
        dMat.get(0).multiply(baseMat);

        for (int i = 1; i < digitsVec.size(); i++) {
            Mat prev = dMat.get(i - 1);
            Mat current = new Mat();
            current.t = new long[n][n];
            // copy prev to current
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                System.arraycopy(prev.t[r], 0, current.t[r], 0, n);
            }
            // square current
            for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
                current.multiply(current);
            }
            // multiply by baseMat
            current.multiply(baseMat);
            dMat.add(current);
        }

        long[] answer = new long[n];
        Arrays.fill(answer, 1);
        long[] powerArr = new long[n];

        for (int idx = digitsVec.size() - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            long digit = digitsVec.get(idx);
            for (int _ = 0; _ < digit; _++) {
                Arrays.fill(powerArr, 0);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        powerArr[j] += answer[i] * dMat.get(idx).t[i][j] % P;
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    answer[i] = powerArr[i] % P;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer[k]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
